mentions.name: ludos-vscode-markdown-kanban
mentions.description: A VS Code extension that organizes lectures using a kanban-style structure stored as markdown files. It supports specific markdown formats to convert content into presentations and other documents, currently via Marp (PDF, PPTX, HTML), with Pandoc support being explored.
mentions.source_excerpt: An vscode extension to organize my lectures using a kanban style structure, saved as markdown files and allows specific md-formats to convert into presentations or other documents (currently marp (pdf, pptx, html) and i'm currently looking into pandoc).
